# University of Hertfordshire Research Profiles

> A comprehensive research profiles hub showcasing the University of Hertfordshire's research centers, departments, and academic outputs across STEM, health sciences, and environmental disciplines.

The Research Profiles site serves as a central directory for discovering research excellence at the University of Hertfordshire, including detailed profiles of research centers, schools, and departments. It aggregates researcher information, research outputs, and collaborative networks to support academic visibility and research discovery.

## Key Topics

- University of Hertfordshire
- Research Excellence Framework
- School of Physics, Engineering & Computer Science
- School of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences
- Centre for AI and Robotics Research
- Centre for Astrophysics Research
- Centre for Climate Change Research
- Centre for Engineering Research
- Research centers and institutes
- Faculty profiles
- Research outputs and projects
- Collaborations network
- Computer science
- Climate change research
- Health services research

## Core Research Hub

- [University of Hertfordshire](https://researchprofiles.herts.ac.uk/en/organisations/university-of-hertfordshire): University of Hertfordshire main organization profile in Hatfield, UK
- [Research Profiles Home](https://researchprofiles.herts.ac.uk): University of Hertfordshire research profiles hub showcasing research centers and outputs

## Schools and Academic Departments

- [School of Physics, Engineering & Computer Science](https://researchprofiles.herts.ac.uk/en/organisations/school-of-physics-engineering-computer-science): School of Physics, Engineering & Computer Science research and STEM disciplines
- [School of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences](https://researchprofiles.herts.ac.uk/en/organisations/school-of-health-medicine-and-life-sciences-2): School of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences research overview and faculty
- [Department of Physics, Astronomy and Mathematics](https://researchprofiles.herts.ac.uk/en/organisations/department-of-physics-astronomy-and-mathematics): Department of Physics, Astronomy and Mathematics with Bayfordbury Observatory

## Research Centers - Physical Sciences and Engineering

- [Centre for AI and Robotics Research](https://researchprofiles.herts.ac.uk/en/organisations/centre-for-ai-and-robotics-research): Centre for AI and Robotics Research profile and human-robot interaction work
- [Centre for Astrophysics Research (CAR)](https://researchprofiles.herts.ac.uk/en/organisations/centre-for-astrophysics-research-car): Centre for Astrophysics Research profile covering observational astronomy and galaxies
- [Centre for Engineering Research](https://researchprofiles.herts.ac.uk/en/organisations/centre-for-engineering-research): Centre for Engineering Research covering materials, energy and sustainable manufacturing

## Research Centers - Health and Life Sciences

- [Centre for Applied Clinical, Health and Care Research (CACHE)](https://researchprofiles.herts.ac.uk/en/organisations/centre-for-applied-clinical-health-and-care-research-cache): Centre for Applied Clinical, Health and Care Research profile and clinical work
- [Centre for Health Services and Clinical Research](https://researchprofiles.herts.ac.uk/en/organisations/centre-for-health-services-and-clinical-research): Centre for Health Services and Clinical Research profile on public health

## Research Centers - Environment and Agriculture

- [Centre for Climate Change Research (C3R)](https://researchprofiles.herts.ac.uk/en/organisations/centre-for-climate-change-research-c3r): Centre for Climate Change Research focusing on climate impacts and mitigation
- [Centre for Atmospheric and Climate Physics Research](https://researchprofiles.herts.ac.uk/en/organisations/centre-for-atmospheric-and-climate-physics-research): Centre for Atmospheric and Climate Physics Research on aerosols and air quality
- [Centre for Agriculture, Food and Environmental Management Research](https://researchprofiles.herts.ac.uk/en/organisations/centre-for-agriculture-food-and-environmental-management-research): Centre for Agriculture, Food and Environmental Management Research profile
